decision.rationale: The two postings went on the account 51 days before the dispute was opened on 2026-10-23, so they fall within the 120-day limit. The ledger shows two purchases at LARKSPUR APPAREL (MER-000015) on card CRD-000197, each for 228.94 EUR and both posted on 2026-09-02. TXN-008180 is dated 2026-09-01T18:36:44Z and the disputed TXN-008181 is dated 2026-09-01T18:41:44Z. Both carry the same authorisation, AUTH-008363, which was one approved authorisation for 228.94 EUR. That means one authorisation was posted twice. The cardholder has no refund at this merchant on record. Under the rule for one authorisation posted twice, provisional credit is approved for the extra posting, TXN-008181, at 228.94 EUR. That is below the 3,000.00 EUR limit for provisional credit. The cardholder claims 457.88 EUR, the total of both postings. The first posting was a purchase they say they made and authorised, so it is not a duplicate, and the larger claim does not change the credit amount.
